criterion_descriptions: Attempt to navigate to https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/releases (or an equivalent official GitHub releases listing for pytorch/pytorch). Full credit if the agent reaches the listing, OR if GitHub is blocked (CAPTCHA/login wall/rate limit/outage) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and proceeds with a reasonable public alternative source for release info (e.g., official PyTorch release announcements/blog, Git tags page, or mirrored release notes). Partial credit if the attempt is unclear or the alternative source is not credible/authoritative.

Determine the most recent release as ordered/shown on the releases listing (including pre-releases if GitHub shows them as the latest). Full credit if the latest release is correctly selected. If the releases listing cannot be accessed, full credit if the agent uses an authoritative alternative to infer the latest release and explains the basis/limitation. Partial credit if a near-latest release is chosen or if the agent’s rationale is incomplete.

Provide the release tag exactly as shown for the identified latest release (e.g., vX.Y.Z). Full credit for exact match. If the source does not clearly present the tag due to access limitations, full credit if the agent states that the tag could not be verified and provides the best-supported identifier from the alternative source. Partial credit for minor formatting discrepancies when unambiguous.

Provide the release date as shown on GitHub (or the authoritative alternative used). Full credit for the correct date. If the date cannot be reliably obtained due to access/source limitations, full credit if the agent explicitly notes the limitation and provides the closest verifiable date indicator (e.g., announcement date) with attribution. Partial credit for relative time only or minor timezone ambiguity that is acknowledged.

From the latest release notes, record the first three highlight bullet points in the exact displayed order. Full credit if all three bullets are correctly captured and ordered. If release notes are inaccessible or truncated due to external factors, full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot retrieve the release notes and does not fabricate bullets; partial credit if the agent retrieves fewer than three bullets but they are correct and in order.

Stop once the latest release tag, release date, and first three highlight bullets have been recorded. Full credit if the response does not continue with additional releases/bullets beyond what was requested. Also award full credit if the agent stops after a reasonable attempt and clearly reports an unavoidable blocker that prevents completing the extraction. Partial credit if minor extra irrelevant context is included but the required information (when obtainable) is clearly present.
